dedupe_keys.name: swiss transport outlook 2050 verkehrsperspektiven 2050 results and visum model versions

description: The Swiss Transport Outlook 2050 (Verkehrsperspektiven 2050, VP 2050) publishes its results and transport model versions on Zenodo. The results record includes a data description, road load values for Switzerland in 2040 and 2050 as GeoPackage files, travel time and distance matrices for road and public transport on the average workday, and PDF load maps. Separate records hold PTV Visum model versions containing road and public transport volumes on networks: the average workday (DWV), the average daily traffic (DTV) and the morning and evening peak hours (7 to 8 h and 17 to 18 h), for 2040 and 2050, with the evening peak versions 6 to 10 GB per file. Coverage is Switzerland. Access: free downloads under CC BY 4.0, published 2022-04-08; further scenarios, sensitivities and in-between years are available from ARE on request. Caveats: the model versions need PTV Visum and very large files, and the daily and peak-hour versions cover only the BASIS scenario. It supports long-term network flow and capacity planning, scenario analysis and the evaluation of road and rail disruptions in future networks, and complements the Swiss NPVM and PTV Visum records catalogued here.
name: Swiss Transport Outlook 2050 (Verkehrsperspektiven 2050) results and Visum model versions
provider: Federal Office for Spatial Development (ARE), Switzerland
